description: THREAT-EXP. Round 1 of the Custodes mirror, P1 Movement, both seats HUMAN. P2's Allarus Custodians (275pt melee unit) is staged 4" short of the centre objective, so P1 units heading there move into its charge reach. Clicking Suggest (K) opens the breakdown card: the Danger term is now weighted by the expected melee damage that enemy would do to the moving unit (share of its wounds lost x its points value) rather than the target-blind 0.3-3.0 threat level, and the per-pair weighting is logged as [THREAT-EXP]. Nothing is executed.

steps.comment: stage P2 Allarus centroid at (800,1150), on the edge of obj_center
